column1: # What the downloaded APK says (its package, its one signing certificate), what it must be (package, the catalog's pinned certificate, the release event's certificate), strict|loose, one|many signers, ok|refuse.
# "-" = empty (unreadable, or not given). strict = a sibling app from the catalog, loose = this app's own update.
# The 7th field is "one" (a single signer) or "many" (more than one signer: always refused, strict or loose).
# Read by the Rust tests (archive_ok) and ApkCheckTest (Java, ApkCheck.verify): one decision, two implementations.
